mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} (primary_key, source, contract_name, contract_number, contract_type, buyer, seller, vender_code,vender_contact, enterprise_code, user_code, language, payment_strategy, column_titles, amount_title, state, clauses_chs, clauses_en, product_detail, contract_time, data_version, sign_areas, purchase_contract, sell_quotation, buyer_quotation, temp_data, attachments,delete_flag,business_belong) VALUES (#{model.contractCode}, #{model.source}, #{model.contractName}, #{model.contractNumber}, #{model.contractType}, #{model.buyer}, #{model.seller}, #{model.venderCode},#{model.venderContact}, #{model.ownedEnterpriseCode}, #{model.userCode}, #{model.language}, #{model.paymentStrategy}, #{model.columnTitles}, #{model.amountTitle}, #{model.state}, #{model.clausesChs}, #{model.clausesEn}, #{model.productDetail}, #{model.contractTime}, #{model.dataVersion}, #{model.signAreas}, #{model.purchaseContract}, #{model.sellQuotation}, #{model.buyerQuotation}, null, #{model.attachments}, 'f',#{model.businessBelong})
